title: The constant coefficient map on sections commutes with direct image
statement: For every topological commutative ring B, fixed coefficient identification eR at the profinite point, scheme morphism j:U→T, and object V of T_proet, the sheafification unit followed by the pulled constant-ring identification on T and the direct-image coefficient map equals the corresponding unit and identification on U evaluated on the base change of V. There is no module, encoding functor, finiteness or discreteness assumption.

source.place: Proposition 5.3.2 and Lemmas 5.4.1 and 5.4.3; Stacks Project Tag 09AK

proof.text: Apply the coefficient comparison at the pullback of the terminal pro-etale object over Spec Z.

Obtain the arrow from the base-changed terminal object to V using terminality. In the opposite site, use naturality of condensedPushforwardHom and of the two maps from constant presheaves to propagate the terminal equality to V.
